versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ תּ֭וֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה־עֹ֑רֶף פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃

controles.web: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
controles.kjv: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
controles.livre: O homem que age com teimosia,  mesmo depois de muitas repreensões, será tão destruído que não terá mais cura.

versos.hebraico: בִּרְב֣וֹת צַ֭דִּיקִים יִשְׂמַ֣ח הָעָ֑ם וּבִמְשֹׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע יֵאָ֥נַֽח עָֽם׃

controles.web: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
controles.kjv: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
controles.livre: Quando os justos se engrandecem, o povo se alegra; mas quando o perverso domina, o povo geme.

versos.hebraico: אִֽישׁ־אֹהֵ֣ב חָ֭כְמָה יְשַׂמַּ֣ח אָבִ֑יו וְרֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹנ֗וֹת יְאַבֶּד־הֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
controles.kjv: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
controles.livre: O homem que ama a sabedoria alegra a seu pai; mas o companheiro de prostitutas gasta os bens.

versos.hebraico: מֶ֗לֶךְ בְּ֭מִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִ֣יד אָ֑רֶץ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּרוּמ֣וֹת יֶֽהֶרְסֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
controles.kjv: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
controles.livre: O rei por meio da justiça firma a terra; mas o amigo de subornos a transtorna.

versos.hebraico: גֶּ֭בֶר מַחֲלִ֣יק עַל־רֵעֵ֑הוּ רֶ֝֗שֶׁת פּוֹרֵ֥שׂ עַל־פְּעָמָֽיו׃

controles.web: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
controles.kjv: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
controles.livre: O homem que lisonjeia a seu próximo arma uma rede para seus pés.

versos.hebraico: בְּפֶ֤שַֽׁע אִ֣ישׁ רָ֣ע מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יָר֥וּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ׃

controles.web: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
controles.kjv: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
controles.livre: Na transgressão do homem mau há uma armadilha; mas o justo se alegra e se enche de alegria.

versos.hebraico: יֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק דִּ֣ין דַּלִּ֑ים רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לֹא־יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃

controles.web: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
controles.kjv: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
controles.livre: O justo considera a causa judicial dos pobres; mas o perverso não entende este conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָ֭צוֹן יָפִ֣יחוּ קִרְיָ֑ה וַ֝חֲכָמִ֗ים יָשִׁ֥יבוּ אָֽף׃

controles.web: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
controles.kjv: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
controles.livre: Homens zombadores trazem confusão a cidade; mas os sábios desviam a ira.

versos.hebraico: אִֽישׁ־חָכָ֗ם נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת־אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל וְרָגַ֥ז וְ֝שָׂחַ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין נָֽחַת׃

controles.web: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
controles.kjv: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
controles.livre: O homem sábio que disputa no julgamento contra um tolo, mesmo se perturbado ou rindo, não terá descanso.

versos.hebraico: אַנְשֵׁ֣י דָ֭מִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־תָ֑ם וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
controles.kjv: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
controles.livre: Homens sanguinários odeiam o honesto; mas os corretos procuram o seu bem.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־ר֭וּחוֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝חָכָ֗ם בְּאָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
controles.kjv: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
controles.livre: O louco mostra todo o seu ímpeto; mas o sábio o mantém sob controle.

versos.hebraico: מֹ֭שֵׁל מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־דְּבַר־שָׁ֑קֶר כָּֽל־מְשָׁרְתָ֥יו רְשָׁעִֽים׃

controles.web: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
controles.kjv: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
controles.livre: O governante que dá atenção a palavras mentirosas, todos os seus servos serão perversos.

versos.hebraico: רָ֤שׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּכָכִ֣ים נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ מֵ֤אִיר־עֵינֵ֖י שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.
controles.kjv: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the Lord lighteneth both their eyes.
controles.livre: O pobre e o enganador se encontram: o SENHOR ilumina aos olhos de ambos.

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֣ט בֶּֽאֱמֶ֣ת דַּלִּ֑ים כִּ֝סְא֗וֹ לָעַ֥ד יִכּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
controles.kjv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
controles.livre: O rei que julga aos pobres por meio da verdade, seu trono se firmará para sempre.

versos.hebraico: שֵׁ֣בֶט וְ֭תוֹכַחַת יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה וְנַ֥עַר מְ֝שֻׁלָּ֗ח מֵבִ֥ישׁ אִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
controles.kjv: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
controles.livre: A vara e a repreensão dão sabedoria; mas o rapaz deixado solto envergonha a sua mãe.

versos.hebraico: בִּרְב֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה־פָּ֑שַׁע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים בְּֽמַפַּלְתָּ֥ם יִרְאֽוּ׃

controles.web: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
controles.kjv: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
controles.livre: Quando os perversos se multiplicam, multiplicam-se as transgressões; mas os justos verão sua queda.

versos.hebraico: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ וִֽינִיחֶ֑ךָ וְיִתֵּ֖ן מַעֲדַנִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃פ

controles.web: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
controles.kjv: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
controles.livre: Castiga a teu filho, e ele te fará descansar, e dará prazeres à tua alma.

versos.hebraico: בְּאֵ֣ין חָ֭זוֹן יִפָּ֣רַֽע עָ֑ם וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹרָ֣ה אַשְׁרֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
controles.kjv: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
controles.livre: Não havendo visão profética, o povo fica confuso; porém o que guarda a lei, ele é bem-aventurado.

versos.hebraico: בִּ֭דְבָרִים לֹא־יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּֽי־יָ֝בִ֗ין וְאֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה׃

controles.web: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
controles.kjv: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
controles.livre: O servo não será corrigido por meio de palavras; porque ainda que entenda, mesmo assim ele não responderá corretamente .

versos.hebraico: חָזִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ אָ֣ץ בִּדְבָרָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
controles.kjv: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
controles.livre: Viste um homem precipitado em suas palavras? Mais esperança há para um tolo do que para ele.

versos.hebraico: מְפַנֵּ֣ק מִנֹּ֣עַר עַבְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝אַחֲרִית֗וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֽוֹן׃

controles.web: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
controles.kjv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
controles.livre: Aquele que mima a seu servo desde a infância, por fim ele quererá ser seu filho.

versos.hebraico: אִֽישׁ־אַ֭ף יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבַ֖עַל חֵמָ֣ה רַב־פָּֽשַׁע׃

controles.web: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
controles.kjv: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
controles.livre: O homem que se irrita facilmente levanta brigas; e o furioso multiplica as transgressões.

versos.hebraico: גַּאֲוַ֣ת אָ֭דָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶ֑נּוּ וּשְׁפַל־ר֝֗וּחַ יִתְמֹ֥ךְ כָּבֽוֹד׃

controles.web: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
controles.kjv: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
controles.livre: A arrogância do homem o abaterá; mas o humilde de espírito obterá honra.

versos.hebraico: חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם־גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑וֹ אָלָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יַגִּֽיד׃

controles.web: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
controles.kjv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
controles.livre: Aquele que reparte com o ladrão odeia sua própria alma; ele ouve maldições e não o denuncia.

versos.hebraico: חֶרְדַּ֣ת אָ֭דָם יִתֵּ֣ן מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה יְשֻׂגָּֽב׃

controles.web: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
controles.kjv: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.
controles.livre: O temor do homem arma ciladas; mas o que confia no senhor ficará em segurança.

versos.hebraico: רַ֭בִּים מְבַקְשִׁ֣ים פְּנֵי־מוֹשֵׁ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּט־אִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment cometh from the Lord.
controles.livre: Muitos buscam a face do governante; mas o julgamento de cada um vem do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים אִ֣ישׁ עָ֑וֶל וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע יְשַׁר־דָּֽרֶךְ׃פ

controles.web: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
controles.kjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
controles.livre: O justos odeiam ao homem perverso; e o injusto odeia aos que andam no caminho correto.
